description: What changed in the recorded influenza figures for a Japanese region since a date? Versions this service recorded: new weeks (first_recorded) and revised values (revised, with the old value) of weekly per-sentinel figures, official statuses and school-closure counts, with observed_at, source URL and raw-file sha256, plus tracking_since and fetch gaps. From our own daily records; values the publisher later overwrote stay visible. Free: last 30 days of records. Descriptive statistics only.

dataset.description: Optional filter: sentinel, official_status or school_closure (default all).

health_center.description: Optional health-center area (保健所管内) id or Japanese name, only for prefectures listed in coverage.prefectures_with_local_data.

prefecture.description: JP for the national total, or a prefecture: ISO 3166-2 code (JP-33), 1-2 digit code (33), English (Okayama) or Japanese (岡山県) name.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time with time zone; versions recorded after this time.

name: flu_region_history

events.description: Versions recorded by this service since 'since', oldest first.

history_window.description: Free history window applied to this answer.

clamped.description: true when requested_since was earlier than the free window and the answer covers only the window.

free_days.description: Days of recorded history served free of charge.

older_history.description: Status of recorded history older than the free window.

requested_since.description: The since you asked for (normalized to ISO 8601).

served_since.description: The since actually applied: requested_since, or the start of the free window if requested_since was earlier.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Recorded influenza changes for a region
